title: Pet-Friendly 5BR Private Home on 30A with a Shared Pool
meta_description: Stay in this pet-friendly 5BR, 3BA vacation home in Seacrest Beach on 30A with a shared pool, free tram service to the beach, and a game room. Sleeps 14.
description_expanded: Looking for the perfect beach getaway? Look no further than 448 Beach Bike Way! This spacious 3-story home in the heart of Seacrest Beach is everything you need for a relaxing, fun-filled vacation. With 5 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and enough space for up to 14 guests, it’s the perfect spot for families or groups of friends. Plus, you’re just a 8-minute walk from the beautiful sandy shores!When you step onto the ground floor, you’ll be greeted by a cozy sitting room with comfortable sofas, one of which converts into a queen-sized bed for extra sleeping space. The guest bedrooms, with a King and Queen-sized bed and a shared hallway bathroom, are perfect for families or friends. The oversized garage has been transformed into a game room featuring ping pong and air hockey tables, which are always a hit! For your convenience, there’s also a washer and dryer available during your stay.The second floor is where the magic happens! You’ll love the open living area, complete with a cozy sectional sofa and a large flat-screen TV, great for movie nights or just hanging out. The dining area seats 8, making it ideal for family meals and gatherings. The kitchen is spacious and fully stocked with everything you need, including a coffee maker, keurig, toaster, and refrigerator with an ice maker. There's also a Queen bedroom features an attached bathroom with a second door providing hallway access, while the bunk room includes a twin-over-twin bunk bed. Don’t forget the second-floor patio, the perfect place to enjoy your morning coffee, with a table and chairs for a peaceful start to your day.Head up to the third floor for the ultimate in comfort and relaxation. The master suite features a king-sized bed and an en-suite walk-in steam shower with a double vanity, perfect for unwinding after a day at the beach. There's also a room for the little ones featuring a twin-over-twin bunk bed. And the third-floor patio? It’s a showstopper, with ocean breezes, a TV, a grill, a bar with a sink and refrigerator, and stunning Gulf views. It’s the perfect spot to unwind and take in the beauty of the coast.Beach Access:Enjoy FREE tram service March–October to and from Sunset Beach. Just walk to a tram stop and call for pickup—arrives in ~15 min. Runs daily, 9 AM–5:30 PM.Distance: .4 miles | Time: 8 minutes walkingNearby Attractions:448 Beach Bike Way is located close to a variety of attractions. Explore the nearby George’s Alys Beach, Peddlers Pavilion, and Rosemary Downtown, home to The Pearl and Sugar Shack. 30Avenue offers a selection of dining spots like Amigos, Amicis, Idyll Proper, and Attycats Arcade. Watersound Towncenter features Publix, Ambrosia, Village Market, Nigel’s, and Sweet Henrietta’s.Seacrest Beach II:The showstopper of the area is the 12,000 square-foot lagoon pool. With a waterfall, fountain, and children's splash area we know you'll find your perfect pool day at Seacrest. Surrounded by palm trees and poolside loungers, it might be hard to split your time between this pool and the beautiful Gulf.Your stay at 448 Beach Bike Way comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!Additional Information:* Pet Friendly!* Snowbird Friendly!* Golf carts are not allowed in the Seacrest Beach community.* Parking for 3 cars only.A starter set of amenities is provided: The kitchen includes paper towels, a sponge, dish soap, dishwasher pods, kitchen wipes, trash liners, and laundry pods. Each bathroom has toilet paper, facial and bath soaps, body wash, shampoo, and conditioner. Towels include one body towel and washcloth per guest, plus two hand towels per bathroom.
